column8: TRAILBLAZER-ALZ 3 (NCT05026866, 2,996 participants) enrols people with neither dementia nor mild cognitive impairment: the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, eligibilityModule, checked 2026-11-09) gives ages 55 to 80, requires 'a Telephone Interview for Cognitive Status - modified (TICS-M) score reflective of intact cognitive functioning' and 'a phosphorylated tau (P-tau) result consistent with the presence of amyloid pathology', and excludes mild cognitive impairment. The primary endpoint is time to clinical progression in participants whose baseline Clinical Dementia Rating is 0. Kisunla's label is the mild cognitive impairment and mild dementia stage, so none of this population is in it, and the registry indexes the study under Alzheimer Disease, the same descriptor the symptomatic studies get. The second preclinical study, NCT07571161, enrols in China and is not named here because the book models the US.

column4: Cystic fibrosis without CFTR modulator benefit
column8: ARCT-032 is not for cystic fibrosis. It is for the part of it the modulators cannot reach, and Arcturus says so in its own filing: 'Other treatments are required to target Class I mutations (no CFTR produced; approximately 10% of CF cases worldwide), and people who are intolerant or have poor response to CFTR modulator therapies. We are initially focusing ARCT-032 on these groups of patients' (FY2025 10-K 0001193125-26-088391). The Phase 2 NCT06747858 enrols 'CF adults who do not benefit from current CFTR modulators, including those with Class I null mutations' (Q3 2026 10-Q 0001193125-26-449901). MeSH has no descriptor for the group, so the registry files the study under Cystic Fibrosis (D003550), the same term Trikafta and Alyftrek are indexed under. Separating it is not a refinement: the book holds one prevalence per disease and the two models mean different things by the word. vrtx_trikafta.csv carries prevalence 701 equal to incidence, which is the line-of-therapy convention for a franchise already treating everyone prevalent, so its pool is each year's birth cohort. ARCT-032 has treated nobody, so its pool at launch is the prevalent population that modulators do not serve. Both are right about their own product and they cannot share a row.
